# Proposal: NLB Legal Team Internal Knowledge Base
**Prepared by:** Kvant Consulting
**For:** NLB d.d. — Legal Operations
**Date:** 2024-04-08
**Version:** 2.0 (revised after kickoff meeting March 11 and data access discussion March 25)
**Contact:** Anja Štrukelj, Tine Hribar

---

## Executive Summary

NLB's Legal Operations team handles a high volume of repetitive internal queries about banking regulations, internal policy, and contract templates. Following the kickoff meeting in March and subsequent discussions about data scope and access constraints, Kvant proposes a phased RAG implementation covering NLB's policy manuals and Bank of Slovenia regulatory circulars.

This revised proposal reflects the agreed Phase 1 scope: approximately 1,800 documents, Slovenian-first, hosted on Hetzner (EU data residency). The contract archive and compliance committee minutes are deferred to Phase 2.

**Proposed budget, Phase 1: €48,000**
**Estimated timeline: 16 weeks** (delayed start due to data transfer protocol requirements; realistic project start April 14)

---

## Problem Statement

NLB legal and compliance analysts spend an estimated 3–4 hours per person per day on information retrieval across fragmented document stores — internal SharePoint, the Bank of Slovenia portal, and institutional memory. The current Confluence search returns full documents rather than relevant passages, and provides no synthesis or citation.

Specific pain points confirmed in the March 11 meeting:
- Regulatory circulars are not removed when superseded; older documents create confusion
- No mechanism to flag when a policy has been updated
- Query time for cross-referencing regulatory requirements against internal policy averages 45–90 minutes per query

---

## Proposed Solution

A conversational retrieval assistant with mandatory source citation, hosted entirely on NLB-approved infrastructure, with a confidence-based refusal mechanism for out-of-corpus queries.

### Architecture

**Document corpus (Phase 1):**
- Internal policy manuals: ~600 documents, updated quarterly
- Bank of Slovenia regulatory circulars, 2018–present: ~1,200 documents
- Total: ~1,800 documents

**Embedding and retrieval:**
- Embeddings: `text-embedding-3-large` (OpenAI) — tested against Voyage; text-embedding-3-large performs adequately on Slovenian regulatory text at lower cost
- Vector store: Qdrant, single-node, Hetzner Falkenstein (FSN1 datacenter, Germany)
- Retrieval: hybrid dense + BM25, reciprocal rank fusion
- Metadata: document date, document type, status (active / potentially superseded), source authority
- Supersession detection: rule-based heuristic using document dates and title similarity; flagged in UI with "this document may have been updated" warning — not guaranteed accurate, requires user verification

**Generation:**
- GPT-4o with system-prompt-enforced citation (every claim must reference a source chunk)
- "I don't know" behavior: explicit refusal when retrieval confidence below 0.78
- No document synthesis across more than 4 source chunks per answer (limits confabulation risk on complex queries)

**Interface:**
- FastAPI backend, React frontend (internal NLB network only)
- SSO integration with NLB Active Directory (to be confirmed — see Assumptions)
- Query logging for audit purposes (NLB compliance requirement)
- Per-user query history (30-day retention)

**Evaluation:**
- RAGAS-based automated eval on 80-question golden dataset
- Golden dataset prepared with NLB legal team during onboarding (Weeks 4–5)
- LangSmith for tracing throughout development
- Hallucination rate on unanswerable questions: target <15%

---

## Scope

**In scope:**
- Ingestion pipeline for 1,800 documents (PDF, DOCX, structured text)
- Hybrid retrieval system with metadata filtering
- Generation layer with citation enforcement
- Supersession detection heuristic (best-effort, not guaranteed)
- FastAPI + React UI
- Active Directory SSO (if confirmed — see Assumptions)
- RAGAS evaluation report
- Training session for NLB legal team (half day, on-site)
- 60 days post-launch support

**Out of scope:**
- Contract archive (~2,400 documents) — Phase 2
- Compliance committee meeting minutes — Phase 2
- Integration with NLB's core banking systems
- Automatic document ingestion from Bank of Slovenia portal (manual refresh quarterly)
- Legal advice or interpretation (system provides retrieval, not counsel)

---

## Phases and Timeline

| Phase | Weeks | Key Activities | Milestone |
|-------|-------|----------------|-----------|
| Data transfer and audit | 1–3 | SFTP setup with NLB security, doc audit, metadata extraction | Corpus ready for ingestion |
| Ingestion pipeline | 4–5 | Chunking, embedding, Qdrant indexing | Corpus indexed |
| Golden dataset preparation | 5–6 | Workshop with NLB legal team (2 sessions) | 80 Q&A pairs |
| RAG system development | 6–10 | Retrieval, generation, citation layer, refusal logic | Internal prototype |
| UI development | 8–11 | FastAPI, React, SSO (if confirmed) | UI prototype |
| Evaluation and iteration | 11–13 | RAGAS eval, human review, threshold tuning | Eval report |
| UAT with NLB team | 13–15 | User testing, feedback, fixes | UAT sign-off |
| Production deployment | 15–16 | Hetzner deployment, monitoring setup | Go-live |
| Training and handover | 16 | On-site training, documentation | Project close |

---

## Team Allocation

| Team Member | Role | Weeks Active | Est. Days |
|-------------|------|--------------|-----------|
| Anja Štrukelj | Project lead, client liaison | 1–16 | 20 |
| Žiga Potočnik | RAG architecture, retrieval | 4–13 | 28 |
| Nika Bregar | Ingestion pipeline, data engineering | 1–7 | 18 |
| Rok Lampret | UI development, API | 8–15 | 16 |
| Matic Demšar | Infrastructure, DevOps | 1–2, 15–16 | 8 |
| Maša Vidmar | Technical review (part-time) | Ongoing | 6 |
| Eva Kos | Project management | 1–16 | 8 |

---

## Budget

| Item | Cost (EUR) |
|------|------------|
| Discovery, data transfer coordination, audit | €5,200 |
| Ingestion pipeline development | €10,800 |
| RAG system (retrieval + generation layer) | €14,000 |
| UI development + SSO integration | €8,500 |
| Evaluation framework + golden dataset | €4,200 |
| DevOps + production deployment | €3,800 |
| Training, documentation, handover | €2,400 |
| Infrastructure (Hetzner, 3 months pre-handover) | €900 |
| Contingency (8%) | €3,600 |
| **Total** | **€53,400** |

**Note:** This revised budget is €5,400 above the €48,000 figure discussed in the March 11 kickoff. The delta reflects the SSO integration (not in original scope — confirmed requirement March 25) and the additional data transfer coordination effort (SFTP setup with NLB security is estimated at 4–5 days vs. 1–2 in the original scope). We are happy to discuss if the SSO integration can be deferred to reduce cost.

OpenAI API costs: estimated €300–500/month at projected query volumes. Not included in above.

---

## Assumptions

- NLB IT provides a dedicated technical contact for SFTP and Active Directory coordination within the first two weeks
- SSO integration uses standard SAML 2.0 or OAuth 2.0 — non-standard protocols will require additional scoping
- Source documents are predominantly machine-readable (NLB IT confirmed approximately 90% have text layers; remainder will require OCR pass at no additional cost if under 200 documents)
- NLB legal team makes two team members available for golden dataset workshops (Weeks 5–6), approximately 4 hours each session
- Project start: April 14, 2025. Delays to data transfer timeline will push all subsequent phases proportionally

---

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|------------|--------|------------|
| Data access delay (SFTP setup) | High | High | Begin prototype on synthetic data during weeks 1–3 |
| Compliance team rejects GPT-4o API usage | Medium | High | Prepare Llama 3.1 70B on-prem fallback option (scope TBD) |
| Supersession detection heuristic has low accuracy | Medium | Medium | Clear UI warning; user responsibility to verify currency |
| NLB legal team unavailable for golden dataset | Medium | Medium | Schedule in SOW; delay is client-side risk |
| Slovenian regulatory text retrieval quality below expectations | Low | Medium | Embedding model evaluation in week 4 before full indexing |

---

## Notes

This proposal supersedes the verbal scope discussed in the February 22 scoping call. The budget increase will require sign-off from Petra Kobal and, per the March 25 discussion, likely Damjan Repič as well. We recommend a brief call before circulating for signature.
